title: Shopify Grew 32%. So Why Did the Stock Drop? #shorts
description: Shopify grew revenue 32% in the third quarter, yet the stock fell about 6% on Tuesday. Total order volume and subscription sales came in a little under what analysts expected.

beats.say: Shopify fell about six percent on Tuesday, even though its sales jumped thirty-two percent.

visual.label: Tuesday afternoon
visual.question: Sales jumped 32%. So why the drop?

beats.say: Its report looked strong. Revenue up thirty-two percent. Yet shares still sold off.

visual.headline: Shopify Sustains Rapid Growth with Revenue Up 32% and Free Cash Flow Margin of 22%

beats.say: Quick quiz. Which number spooked investors? A, revenue. B, cash flow. C, order volume. The answer: C. Just under what analysts expected.
Order volume and subscription sales both landed a little light. With the stock priced high, there was little room for a miss. So shares fell.
Markets react to the number they were watching, not the headline. And that's why
